title: High root filesystem usage
description: The root filesystem is at least 90% full. This may prevent updates or applications from writing files.
solution: Identify large directories with du before deleting anything.
Check package cache usage before considering cache cleanup.
risk: Do not delete system files or personal files without checking them first.

title: A systemd unit has failed
description: One or more systemd units are reported as failed. The reason depends on the specific unit.
solution: Inspect the affected unit with systemctl status UNIT.
Read relevant logs with journalctl -u UNIT.
Determine the cause before attempting a repair.
risk: Do not restart or disable a system service until you understand what it does.

title: DNS name resolution failed
description: The system could not resolve archlinux.org even though a public IP connection succeeded.
solution: Check whether other domain names also fail to resolve.
Inspect the current DNS configuration without changing it.
Check the network manager or resolver logs for errors.
Do not replace DNS settings until the cause is understood.
risk: Changing DNS settings may interrupt connectivity or conflict with network management tools.

title: Public IP connectivity test failed
description: A TCP connection to 1.1.1.1 on port 443 failed or timed out. This alone does not prove that the entire internet connection is down.
solution: Check whether the network interface is connected.
Inspect the default route with ip route.
Check the router or active network connection.
Repeat the test because firewalls or network policies may block the target.
risk: Do not restart networking or change routes until the cause is understood.
